A typical employee would most likely **leave the box on today’s destruction manifest and release the full batch on time**.

The extension request does not authorize a hold: it is still pending, permission is not available until tomorrow, and later permission cannot retroactively authorize today’s change. The manager also explicitly said not to make discretionary extensions. Removing the box from the cage without registered permission would itself be a policy violation and likely appear in the audit.

The employee might urgently call the duty manager or Claire to confirm the situation and document the outcome, but unless an authorized exception were obtained before 13:30, the box would be destroyed at 14:30 and Claire’s Wednesday collection would no longer be possible.
